question.text: For an ordinary (non-Large Value Fund) Cat III AIF registration or scheme launch, which of the following is a MANDATORY Service Provider?

explanation.text: The Logic: For a regular (non-Large Value Fund) Cat III AIF, the PPM must be filed with SEBI through a SEBI-registered Merchant Banker, who also submits the due diligence certificate (pp. 79, 107). The Trap: Stock exchanges, tax advisors and financial planners are either optional or unrelated to the SEBI PPM filing requirement. Note: Large Value Fund schemes are exempt from the merchant-banker PPM filing route (p. 108), so the rule above applies to ordinary Cat III AIF PPMs.
